annotations.title: The verdict line for one filed move

description: One guru's disclosed move in one ticker, with the sentence Deep Values publishes about it and every number behind it: the company's legal name beside the ticker (`name`, null where we hold none), the three dates (traded by, filed, seen), the quarter-end close, the current price, and the intrinsic value band. `value` is the callable band (the lead value ±25%: Owner Earnings, else the DCF, else Damodaran) and is null whenever the verdict is not a call; `estimates` always carries what the valuation methods actually said, their lowest and highest central estimate, so a reader told we cannot call it can see why. One of six deterministic states — below_value, inside_band, above_value, ran_ahead, too_uncertain, no_value — computed the same way for every caller. The band is Deep Values' lead intrinsic value (the one the apps headline: Owner Earnings first) plus or minus 25%, and `too_uncertain` ("Our estimates disagree too much to call this one.") replaces the three band states when the methods' own central estimates are more than 3x apart, or one of them is not positive: the lead value still exists, but `value` is null because it is not a range anyone should be told a price sits inside; `estimates` shows how far apart the methods are. It is distinct from `no_value`, which means no valuation was computed at all. Before the band is published its mid is checked against the current price (positive, at most 20x the price, a price under five days old; under 0.05x is served with the flag `iv_far_below_price`) and for currency (`currency_consistent`: the statements behind it are in USD, the price's currency, or were converted to USD; a converted band carries `fx` on `values.value_band_mid` naming the original currency and rate; when the currency is not known the answer carries the flag `currency_unverified` instead); on a failure `value` and `estimates` are null, the verdict reads `no_value`, `withheld` is true, `checks.failed` names the check, and the call is not charged. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/verdict/{ticker}, e.g. https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/verdict/AAPL?guru=warren-buffett — 0.02 credits per call; works with no credentials up to 5 call(s)/day per address) Missing data? Call `request_data`.

quarter.description: Quarter end; default = the most recent quarter we hold.

ticker.description: The real ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL; share classes as BRK.B or BRK-B. Substitute it into the path (/fundamentals/AAPL), never the literal {ticker}.
